typed:stopping_rules: Implementation snapshot or launch comparison mismatch - do not launch; evidence-integrity failure.
Admission failure - do not launch; failed_infrastructure; nothing substituted.
Staged-source digest mismatch - stop in Stage P; evidence-integrity failure.
Pinned-revision source unreachable - stop in Stage P before any factoring; failed_infrastructure; nothing substituted.
C-FIELD extraction cross-check fails - stop in Stage P; outcome I_TEXT.
A C-FIELD case not rejected with exactly its expected reasons, or a C-FIELD-MUTATION result other than expected - stop in Stage P before any factoring; outcome N2.
Any control construction leaves its window - stop; failed_infrastructure (not negative).
A construction control rejected by the confounder check - stop; outcome I_CONTROL_COLLISION.
Any construction-control gate fails on either path - stop after writing controls_receipt.json; outcome N1; no null-arm or deployed factorization.
Any C-BOUND gate fails on either path - stop after writing controls_receipt.json; outcome N4; no null-arm or deployed factorization.
Any floor_invariant violation (change.D2_typed_costs) on any row or control, on either path - stop; outcome N3.
Governing-text hash mismatch, or a forbidden module detected, at any stage boundary - stop; evidence-integrity failure.
Per integer - stop factoring when its budget is spent; keep the certified partial factorization and the recorded parts; the branch is BOUND.
Memory protection or crash - checkpoint completed rows; incomplete rows are failed_infrastructure.

There is NO stop-and-escalate. Apart from the validity rules above (N3 and the VOID and UNPINNED statuses, which test the instrument on every row), no stop depends on any deployed-row or null-arm value. After Stage C passes, the package runs every null-arm and deployed row to completion.
Never execute Cheon's algorithms, never generate or consume any auxiliary power, never enter a protocol-supply stage.

texts.8e07dde65d142e768495ff99038e135e6baf5cd6: Timeout, crash, or OOM => failed_infrastructure; never a mathematical negative.

texts.07892c23bc0284f3ac0882238dbcd64a0e1b9999: Dropping a frozen curve after seeing its factors => invalid_measurement.
texts.e91d80eb122d699aa96c59a80f1e669aefc0e97f: Mixing modelled E(r) and measured factorizations in one unlabeled column => invalid_measurement.
texts.510e2b80ba72a0c7d82870ea06d677012ba8fab9: Omitting r+1 => incomplete row, not a negative.

outcomes.condition: Launch comparison and admission passed; C-FIELD and C-FIELD-MUTATION met their gates; every gate of C-PLANT-M, C-PLANT-P, C-INERT, C-PLANT-PL and C-BOUND held on both paths; no floor_invariant violation; every deployed row is PINNED (or UNPINNED with a recorded source failure) and every pinned deployed branch is EXACT or BOUND with product check and path agreement; the null arm is complete; every required artifact is present.
As S_VALID_TABLE except that one or more deployed branches are VOID under a validity rule. The void branches are listed with reasons. Not negative about any curve.

Any gate of C-PLANT-M, C-PLANT-P, C-INERT or C-PLANT-PL fails on either path. The typed census pipeline (factoring, certification, evaluation or binning) is falsified at the size of the failing control, and no null-arm or deployed row is read.
A C-FIELD case is not rejected with exactly its expected reasons, or a C-FIELD-MUTATION result differs from its expected reasons. The pin confounder check is falsified; nothing is factored.
Any reported exponent or bound lies below its branch's analytic floor (beyond the 10^-45 slack), or any evaluated T_plus(d) < d. The evaluator is falsified and the whole table is void.

A C-BOUND state returns a status, witness set, witness, bound, bin, bin_at_least or boundary_flag other than the value this text fixes (H-AUXIN-6db354 falsification_conditions item 5). The BOUND rules are falsified and no null-arm or deployed row is read.

A C-FIELD expression differs from the field prime extracted for its row. This localises to this text's expression or to the extraction, and the run cannot tell which. Stop in Stage P. Not negative, not a result; the amendment returns to review.
A construction-control integer is rejected by the confounder check. Stop. Not negative, not a result; the amendment returns to review.

Launch-comparison or admission failure, staged-digest mismatch, unreachable pinned source, window exit, crash, timeout outside the per-integer budget, OOM, forbidden module or tool absence. Never negative.

typed:success_criterion.decidability: (F-J3-1, entry 15.) Each outcome is decided from the gate verdicts, statuses, validity rules and invariants in metrics.primary alone. The only way a deployed-row result enters an outcome is through the validity rules that test the instrument on every row: N3 (the floor invariant), VOID (which separates S_VALID_TABLE from S_PARTIAL_TABLE) and UNPINNED. None of these is a threshold on a deployed-row exponent, bound, bin or divisor, and no deployed-row value is compared with any cut-off chosen for it.

67ee005324fd2f50ccffb602abe35b1aff99eff0.typed:falsification_criterion: The amended census instrument is falsified by N1, N2, N3 or N4. It is not falsified by any deployed-row or null-arm value, by a BOUND row, by an I_TEXT or I_CONTROL_COLLISION stop, or by an infrastructure failure.

texts.b6f2012f4377a28b4201306db20ac48fed53c794: For every branch of every deployed row, construction control, C-BOUND state and null-arm sample, three fields are reported: bin, bin_at_least and boundary_flag, each with exactly the value given here. EXACT: bin is given by definitions.bins; bin_at_least equals bin; boundary_flag is as definitions.bins defines it. BOUND: let s be the depth of the witnessed upper bound and boundary_flag the flag that definitions.bins computes on s. If boundary_flag is false and s >= 3/4 + tau, bin is NEAR_FLOOR and bin_at_least is NEAR_FLOOR (the true value is at least as deep). Otherwise bin is UNDETERMINED and bin_at_least is the bin that definitions.bins gives an EXACT value of depth s (so a witnessed depth within tau of 3/4 gives UNDETERMINED, bin_at_least INTERMEDIATE and boundary_flag true). VOID: bin, bin_at_least and boundary_flag are all null. UNPINNED rows have no branches and report none of the three. This clause and definitions.bins never give two answers, and no status and bin combination leaves bin_at_least undefined.

texts.f4aebb32cf6d84376bbcff245e670bad5e052cbd: Every leaf of the combined text has exactly one governing layer, named in governing_text_table of this file: v1 (specification.yaml), typed-by-hash (AMD-20260926-typed.yaml, bound by sha256 and incorporated through AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml), narrow-by-hash (AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml, bound by sha256 and incorporated through this file) or gated (this file). The layers are ordered v1, typed-by-hash, narrow-by-hash, gated. A leaf that a later layer supersedes is governed by the latest layer that supersedes it. A leaf superseded only in a span is split into a span row and an outside row, each with one layer. An ADDITION (an entry with adds_to) supersedes nothing: it is a leaf of the layer that states it, and the text read at the path it names is the UNION of the held field's governing text and every addition to that path, cross-referenced in path_additions. No leaf is decided by reading two layers; a path is read across layers only as that union, and no union member overrides another.

78cd7c3a628542ded15cae298d2919cec3830e0a.from: An alarm return (PARI error e_ALARM) means the call timed out;
78cd7c3a628542ded15cae298d2919cec3830e0a.replacement: The call is evaluated by the cypari2 Pari instance of corrective.tools.certificate_and_factoring_library.stack_allocation, as p("alarm(A, factor(n))") with A and n written in decimal. RECOGNITION, in this order: (i) if the call raises cysignals.signals.AlarmInterrupt, caught by naming that class, the call timed out (that class derives from KeyboardInterrupt, not from Exception, so a handler for Exception does not catch it); (ii) if the call returns a PARI object of type t_ERROR whose errname is e_ALARM (the gp-interface form of the same event), the call timed out; in case (i) or (ii) the part stays unfactored and the timeout is recorded together with which form was observed; (iii) if the call returns an object of type t_MAT, the call completed and that matrix is its factorization; (iv) any other exception, any other return type, or termination of the process by a signal is a crash under stopping_rules (memory protection or crash), never a timeout. After (i) or (ii) the same Pari instance serves later calls; admission item (3) checks that it remains usable.

3487e39c1577259110614c3a070e77d4673fc040.from: For an EXACT value: NEAR_FLOOR if
3487e39c1577259110614c3a070e77d4673fc040.replacement: For an EXACT value the rules are applied IN THIS ORDER and the first that applies gives the bin: (i) if boundary_flag is true, the value takes the bin on its lower-depth side, so s within tau of 3/4 gives INTERMEDIATE and s within tau of 1/4 gives NEAR_CEILING; (ii) NEAR_FLOOR if s >= 3/4 + tau; (iii) NEAR_CEILING if s <= 1/4 - tau; (iv) INTERMEDIATE otherwise. PRECEDENCE: the flag rule (i) precedes the cut-off rules (ii) and (iii). So s = 3/4 + tau exactly is flagged and gives INTERMEDIATE, s = 1/4 - tau exactly is flagged and gives NEAR_CEILING, and no s receives two bins.

Through it, the fields of AMD-20260926-typed.yaml that its incorporates block incorporates, EXCEPT the typed spans listed below with layer typed-by-hash. Each incorporated field governs exactly as its bytes read in the file whose sha256 is stated here.
texts.2b0868192037dd75deddd3660f1128299a75358a: Before any use, a reader or executor computes the sha256 of AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml and of AMD-20260926-typed.yaml and compares each with the value above. A span is never cut from a value that an earlier layer has already replaced.
texts.bed0a9bea9646a931ae579537d8639a9d06504ee: These fields of AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml describe that file's own identity, review round, approval route, provenance or authorization. They are NOT incorporated. The field of the same role in this file governs instead. They carry no protocol content and are therefore not in supersedes_fields. The identity fields experiment_id, hypothesis_id, question_id and goal_id state the same values in both files; this file's govern.
texts.fcb49007dc16eea8c9921081a466bb0e6981e4a5: The envelope fields of AMD-20260926-typed.yaml stay outside the incorporation as envelope_not_incorporated of AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml lists them; span G-ENV below makes the field of the same role in this file govern instead.

expected_value_source.text: Gate 1 of controls[C-BOUND] compares each returned field with the value stated in that state's expected block. After spans G-GATE1, G-BND1 and G-BND3, every declared state states bin, bin_at_least and boundary_flag: BND-1 and BND-3 state bin NEAR_FLOOR, bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR, boundary_flag false; BND-2 states bin UNDETERMINED, bin_at_least NEAR_CEILING, boundary_flag false (held, unchanged). Each stated value equals the value corrective.bin_by_status of AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml gives on that state's witnessed depth: BND-1 and BND-3 are BOUND, unflagged, with depth above 3/4 (each state's held why_fixed_in_advance), and an unflagged depth above 3/4 is at least 3/4 + tau, so bin_by_status gives NEAR_FLOOR and bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR; BND-2 is BOUND, unflagged, with depth below 1/100, below 1/4 - tau, so bin_by_status gives UNDETERMINED and bin_at_least NEAR_CEILING. Hence the value condition success_criterion.outcomes[N4_BOUND_EVALUATOR_FALSIFIED] reads ("the value this text fixes") and the value gate 1 compares with are the same value on every declared state. No C-BOUND state other than BND-1, BND-2 and BND-3 exists in a run (invalidation_rules item 6 of AMD-20260926-typed.yaml). A reviewer who constructs a further BOUND state to test the rule evaluates gate 1 on it against the values corrective.bin_by_status gives on that state's witnessed depth, so on every BOUND state that bins NEAR_FLOOR bin_at_least is defined (NEAR_FLOOR) and gated.

d645d957755a48070fa4473eb3efae584ec7603a.one_outcome: For any evaluator correct under the combined text, and for any evaluator that departs from it on a C-BOUND state, C-BOUND gate 1 and condition N4 have exactly one outcome together: a returned field that differs from the stated value fails gate 1 on that path, stopping_rules item 10 stops the run with N4, and the N4 condition is met by the same field; a returned field equal to the stated value passes gate 1 and does not meet N4. Tabulated in outcome_table.

outcome_table.evaluator: returns every expected field, bin_at_least NEAR_FLOOR
bin_at_least other than NEAR_FLOOR, every other field as expected
outcome_table.under_narrow: gate 1 passed (bin_at_least not stated, so not checked) while the N4 condition was met: two outcomes

outcome_table.evaluator: bin_at_least absent or null (E0 of RT-20260927-730157: correct under the typed text, silent at BOUND NEAR_FLOOR)
outcome_table.under_narrow: gate 1 passed while the N4 condition was met: two outcomes

outcome_table.evaluator: returns every expected field, bin_at_least NEAR_CEILING
bin_at_least other than NEAR_CEILING, or absent
any other expected field wrong (status, witness set, witness, bin, boundary_flag)
paths A and B return different bin_at_least
outcome_table.outcome: N4 only (definitions.gate_evaluation_mode assigns N4 for a C-BOUND gate)
outcome_table.same_as_under_narrow: BND-2 yes; BND-1 and BND-3 no (under narrow gate 1 did not compare bin_at_least there)

d645d957755a48070fa4473eb3efae584ec7603a.tested_meaning_of_N4: Unchanged relative to AMD-20260927-narrow.yaml: N4 tests every field of every declared state against the value the combined text fixes, and on BND-1 and BND-3 that value was already NEAR_FLOOR through corrective.bin_by_status. What changes is that gate 1, and so stopping_rules item 10, now tests the same field. The FC5 row of corrective.falsification_condition_mapping (FC5 -> N4, kept) therefore needs no change.

12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.statement: A deployed row, null-arm sample, construction control or C-FIELD case that the confounder check rejects reports none of the three reporting fields bin, bin_at_least and boundary_flag. It has no branch: a rejected deployed row is invalid_measurement for that row and never factored, a rejected null-arm sample is kept, flagged and not factored, a rejected construction control stops the run (I_CONTROL_COLLISION) before any factoring, and a C-FIELD case is never factored. Its record is the ordered reason list of the confounder check.
12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.why_no_outcome_changes: corrective.bin_by_status assigns the three fields per branch, and a rejected candidate has no branch under the held confounder-check text, so this statement makes explicit what the held text already implies; no gate, stop or outcome reads the three fields of a candidate that has no branch.

12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.declaration: "every construction-control integer" means each construction control's r (the r of C-PLANT-M, C-PLANT-P, C-INERT and C-PLANT-PL), not every integer named in a recipe.
12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.reason: It is the only reading consistent with the held text: stages[C_controls].does runs the confounder check "on each constructed r"; scope_on_controls_and_null_arm fixes the expected outcome for every construction control as NOT REJECTED; and under the other reading clause (2) not_prime would reject every composite recipe integer (D = d1 * d2 of C-PLANT-M, for example), stopping every run with I_CONTROL_COLLISION. The declared reading leaves the integers FP is compared with, and the C-FIELD gates, unchanged. DEC-20260927-f680f7 Q0-3 recorded the same outcome under both readings for clause (1) at the pinned bytes.

12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.declaration: "(hex form)" is descriptive, not a requirement. The cross-check compares the case value with the field prime p that parse rule PR-SP800 extracts, in whichever representation PR-SP800 selects and records.
12d3351dd5bedad2bf325708241788bf1d757657.reason: PR-SP800 governs which representation yields the value and records the one used; a second representation rule inside the cross-check would duplicate it. DEC-20260927-f680f7 Q0-4 recorded that both readings give the same run-time decision at the pinned, hash-fixed bytes.
